description: This file provides low-level Windows system call utilities, including string conversion functions and time-related methods, as part of the golang.org/x/sys/windows package.

methods.name: ByteSliceFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a NUL-terminated byte slice, returning an error if the string contains a NUL byte.

methods.name: BytePtrFromString
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a NUL-terminated byte array representing the string, or an error if the string contains a NUL byte.

methods.name: ByteSliceToString
methods.description: Converts a byte slice with a NUL terminator to a string, removing the terminator and any following bytes.

methods.name: BytePtrToString
methods.description: Converts a pointer to a NUL-terminated byte sequence to a string.

methods.name: Unix (Timespec)
methods.description: Returns the seconds and nanoseconds since the Unix epoch for a Timespec.

methods.name: Unix (Timeval)
methods.description: Returns the seconds and nanoseconds since the Unix epoch for a Timeval.

methods.name: Nano (Timespec)
methods.description: Returns the total nanoseconds for a Timespec.

methods.name: Nano (Timeval)
methods.description: Returns the total nanoseconds for a Timeval.
